slide_1.title: Welcome to RunQuest
slide_1.subtitle: Your Journey as a Competitive Runner.
slide_1.content: Step into the shoes of an athlete. Schedule upcoming races, manage your daily timeline, and train to build peak endurance and rating.

slide_2.title: Daily Training & Energy
slide_2.subtitle: Balance workouts and recovery.
slide_2.content: Execute daily workouts like Easy Runs, Tempo Sessions, and Long Runs using Energy Points. Listen to coach tips and rest to prevent fatigue.

slide_3.title: Jobs, Shop & Gear
slide_3.subtitle: Fuel your career & economy.
slide_3.content: Work daily jobs to earn money in your local currency. Visit the Shop to unlock shoes and stock up on consumable nutrition like gels and hydration mix.

slide_4.title: Race Day & Strategy
slide_4.subtitle: Pacing, weather & checkpoint nutrition.
slide_4.content: Enter scheduled races, select your footwear & nutrition items during preparation, and choose tactics like Negative Split or Surge to cross the finish line!

slide_5.title: Global Community Overall
slide_5.subtitle: All-time statistics live from Firebase.
slide_5.content: See overall community activity across all runners and registered races worldwide in real-time.

slide_6.content: We've detected your location! Pick your runner name, nationality, default currency, and date of birth to get started.

how_to_play.title: How to Play RunQuest
how_to_play.subtitle: Master the art of race scheduling, training, economy, and pacing strategy.
how_to_play.pro_tip_desc: Always buy hydration & gels from the Shop before entering a race! Consumables restore energy during checkpoints and prevent DNF.

scheduling.title: 🗓️ Race Scheduling & Timeline
scheduling.desc: Races must be registered in advance for future days. Use the timeline controls to rest and advance days forward.
scheduling.item1: Browse upcoming calendar events (5K, 10K, Half Marathon, Full Marathon) and pay entry fees in advance.
scheduling.item2: Advancing time moves the game day by day and automatically halts when a registered race day is reached.
scheduling.item3: You cannot compete on the spot without scheduling beforehand!

economy.title: 💼 Jobs, Economy & Sponsors
economy.desc: RunQuest features a single-currency monetary system based on your preferred currency ($/€/¥/Rp).
economy.item1: Work daily jobs to earn cash. Working is limited to once per game day.
economy.item2: Changing jobs carries a strict 7-day cooldown period.
economy.item3: Sign sponsor contracts to receive regular stipends and bonus payouts for hitting race goals.

shop.title: 🏪 Shop & Inventory
shop.desc: Access the central Shop screen to purchase gear, footwear, and consumable nutrition.
shop.item1: Shoes (Daily Trainer, Carbon Racer, Trail) are one-time permanent unlocks that boost performance.
shop.item2: Nutrition items (Water, Electrolytes, Energy Gels, Caffeine) are consumable items with quantity tracking.
shop.item3: Preparation Screen only allows equipping shoes and nutrition items that you currently own.

training.title: 🏃 Daily Workouts & Energy
training.desc: Build your runner's physical attributes through structured training plans.
training.item1: Select daily workouts (Easy Run, Tempo, Intervals, Long Run, Strength) consuming Energy Points (EP).
training.item2: Follow coach recommendations to optimize your training load and prevent overtraining.
training.item3: Rest days regenerate your energy reserves for race day.

race_day.title: ⏱️ Race Day & Live Pacing
race_day.desc: Compete live on race day with strategic nutrition and pacing management.
race_day.item1: Check weather forecast (temperature, humidity, wind) and elevation in the race briefing.
race_day.item2: Select pacing strategies like Negative Split (save energy for end), Steady Pace, or Aggressive Surge.
race_day.item3: Consume water, gels, or electrolytes at checkpoints to manage stamina and avoid hitting the wall.

progression.title: 🏆 Progression & Social
progression.desc: Level up your athlete and share your career milestones.
progression.item1: Earn XP from races and daily challenges to level up and allocate skill points.
progression.item2: Track rival activities, break personal records, and unlock achievements.
progression.item3: Generate and share personalized finisher cards and daily stats graphics.

disclaimer.title: Offline & Unofficial Notice
disclaimer.offline_info: RunQuest is an offline-first simulation game. All progress and data are stored locally in your browser with zero cloud dependencies required.
disclaimer.unofficial_notice: All races, events, sponsors, brands, equipment, and marathons featured in RunQuest are fictional simulation elements. RunQuest is an independent project and is NOT affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by any real-world official athletic organizations or events.

welcome.title: Welcome to RunQuest! 🏃
welcome.content: Let's take a quick tour to help you become a champion runner. We'll walk through the core features of the game.

clock.title: Time is Money (and Fitness) ⏱️
clock.content: This is the game clock. Every action you take moves time forward. Pay attention to the current Day, Week, Month, and Year.

health.title: Health & Energy ⚡
health.content: Your Energy Points (EP) determine what you can do. Training and racing cost EP. Keep your health up to perform better!

expenses.title: Economy & Expenses 💰
expenses.content: You need money to survive and thrive. Keep an eye on your balance and upcoming expenses. You can work to earn more.

training.title: Daily Training 📋
training.content: This is your recommended training for today. Completing workouts builds your fitness and earns you XP.

races.title: Race Calendar 🏆

rest.title: Rest & Advance Time 🌙
